population.kidComparison: The third most populated country on Earth, with over 335 million people across 50 states.

geography.climate: Mostly temperate, but spans tropical weather in Hawaii and Florida to arctic cold in Alaska and arid deserts in the southwest.
geography.terrain: Mix of coastal plains and inland terrain.

flag.description: 13 red and white stripes with a blue rectangle in the top corner holding 50 white stars.

anthem.title: The Star-Spangled Banner
anthem.summary: Written during the War of 1812 after watching a flag survive an overnight bombardment.

exploration.didYouKnow: Yellowstone was the world's very first national park, established in 1872.

regionalTraits: Collects souvenir state quarters in a velvet pouch
Never travels without a vintage baseball cap
Reads road atlases instead of using GPS
